description: The chart is a horizontal stacked bar chart illustrating the percentage breakdown of three components—Context, Generated Response, and Other—for two different methods, labeled "Ours" and "Standard". The vertical axis displays the categorical labels "Ours" at the top and "Standard" at the bottom, without an explicit axis title. The horizontal axis represents the value in percentages on a linear scale; although it lacks an explicit axis line, label, or tick marks, the total length of each stacked bar represents 100%. Each horizontal bar is divided into three stacked segments arranged from left to right. According to the legend at the bottom, the blue segment represents "Context", the brown segment represents "Generated Response", and the green segment represents "Other". Every segment is visually emphasized with an annotation of its exact percentage value centered within the colored block. For the "Ours" category, the bar consists of Context at 60.6% (the largest segment in this bar), Generated Response at 31.7%, and Other at 7.7% (the smallest segment overall). For the "Standard" category, the bar is composed of Context at 23.6%, Generated Response at 51.1% (the largest segment in this bar), and Other at 25.3%. The bars are not sorted by any specific numerical value, as both total 100%, and the segments follow a consistent left-to-right order for both categories.
